heroTitle: Plants, flowers & garden inspiration for every season.
heroText: Montrose Greenhouse — His & Herbs is a full-service florist and seasonal greenhouse in Montrose, Michigan, growing and selling exceptional plants of all types while helping customers find the right flowers, herbs, gifts, and greenery for their homes, gardens, and special moments.
announcement: Open all four seasons. Call for current hours and seasonal availability.
hoursNote: Open all four seasons. Please call for current seasonal hours.
aboutTitle: A local greenhouse with a florist’s touch.
aboutText: From spring annuals and hanging baskets to herbs, perennials, fresh floral work, gifts, and seasonal greenhouse favorites, Montrose Greenhouse — His & Herbs is built around friendly service and beautiful, healthy plants. Visit for inspiration, advice, and a relaxed shopping experience surrounded by color.
servicesIntro: A simple, customer-friendly overview of the core areas of the business. Update this list any time as products and seasons change.

services.title: Full-Service Florist
services.text: Fresh floral arrangements for everyday moments, sympathy, celebrations, holidays, and special requests.

services.title: Seasonal Greenhouse
services.text: Annuals, perennials, herbs, hanging baskets, garden starts, mums, and seasonal favorites throughout the year.

services.title: Plants & Garden Help
services.text: Friendly help choosing plants, pairing colors, planning containers, and finding what fits your space.

services.title: Gifts & Garden Shop
services.text: A charming shop atmosphere with seeds, garden supplies, bulbs, planters, and giftable finds.

seasonIntro: Use this area for what customers should look for during each part of the year.

seasons.title: Spring
seasons.text: Bedding plants, garden starts, herbs, hanging baskets, porch pots, and early-season color.

seasons.title: Summer
seasons.text: Pollinator-friendly plants, container refreshes, perennials, herbs, and bright greenhouse finds.

seasons.title: Fall
seasons.text: Mums, autumn color, pumpkins and gourds when available, fall containers, and cozy garden accents.

seasons.title: Winter
seasons.text: Holiday greens, floral arrangements, gifts, bulbs, indoor inspiration, and seasonal displays.
